name: Meridian — demo backend
_comment: These are the demo project's PUBLIC values. The publishable key is designed to be shipped to browsers and is already present in the built frontend bundle; it grants nothing on its own because every table is protected by RLS - which is exactly what this collection proves. The demo password is published in the README on purpose. No service-role key appears here, and none is needed: a service-role key bypasses RLS and would invalidate every negative test in the collection.
